bullets.text: Chennai received heavy overnight rain causing waterlogging and GCC received 1,212 complaints, so the office should monitor flood relief efforts closely.
Power supply will be suspended in Velachery for maintenance work on Wednesday, so the office should watch for public grievances.
A pension adalath will be held on the 20th to resolve pensioners grievances in Thiruvallur district, so the office should track attendance.

stories.title: Chennai Heavy Rain: Vadapalani Records 132.9 mm; Schools Closed, GCC Receives 1,212 Complaints
takeaways: Vadapalani recorded 132.9 mm of rainfall while the Greater Chennai Corporation received 1,212 public complaints.
Authorities declared school holidays and deployed drainage teams to clear inundated residential neighbourhoods.

stories.title: Power Shutdown Areas in Chennai - Wednesday (30-09-2026)
takeaways: Power supply will be suspended in Velachery areas including Rettaipillaiyar Koil Street and Anna Street on Wednesday.
The five-hour outage from 09.00 AM is required to carry out routine electrical infrastructure maintenance.

stories.title: ஓய்வூதியதாரர்கள் குறை தீர்க்க வரும் 20ல் ’பென்சன் அதாலத்’
takeaways: Thiruvallur district administration has announced a special Pension Adalat to resolve grievances for retired personnel on the 20th.
Pensioners can submit petitions regarding delayed benefits or pension revisions for immediate official review.
